method: Exact B-rep plane slices; actual closed wires discretized at 0.01 mm deflection. CAD and corrected assembly read only.
limitations: OLED supplement glass, frame and mounting hardware are visual approximations; module header mounting height is unmeasured.
The inner-lid gap is measured to a reference plane through the open aperture, not to material above the glass.
The main enclosure face remains 4.60 mm above glass; only the local recessed window rim moves closer.
Physical fit and material load capacity are not established by this model audit.
